# Nestlancer

> Nestlancer — Your dedicated product studio.

Nestlancer is a dedicated product studio for founders, startups, and product teams. Clients submit a brief, receive a milestone-based quote, pay on schedule via Razorpay, and track delivery in one workspace — from discovery through production handoff.

## What Nestlancer does

- Web application development (including MVP builds)
- Mobile app development
- UI/UX design and product design systems
- Custom software and product engineering
- Milestone-based billing with secure Razorpay payments (deposit / mid / final)

## Target audience

- Founders shipping a first product or MVP
- Startups needing a dedicated studio (not a freelancer marketplace)
- Product teams that want transparent quotes, milestones, and in-app collaboration

## Key pages

- [Home](https://nestlancer.com/): Studio overview and engagement model
- [Services](https://nestlancer.com/services): Packages and deliverables
- [Pricing](https://nestlancer.com/pricing): Transparent studio engagements (no SaaS subscription trap)
- [About](https://nestlancer.com/about): Studio mission, workflow, and values
- [Contact](https://nestlancer.com/contact): Project inquiries and partnerships (hello@nestlancer.com)

## Client portal

- Public portfolio and blog live on [app.nestlancer.com](https://app.nestlancer.com/)
- Authenticated client workspace (requests, quotes, payments, messages) is private and not for indexing

- [Full documentation for AI systems](https://nestlancer.com/llms-full.txt): Extended service breakdowns, milestones, workflows, tech stack, and contacts
